Name: Subtle Variant Textures for Adopt 'n' Skin
Author: ST753M
Description:
This is a skin pack for the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4011?tab=description]Adopt N Skin[/url], by Gathouria.  To use, add the files to the \Mods\AdoptSkin\assets\skins folder.  If you are also using other skins for barn and coop animals you will need to re-number these ones to the next available numbers.

I've really been enjoying playing with Adopt N Skin in my most recent play-through along with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538?tab=forum]Animal Husbandry Mod[/url].  However, for the coop and barn animals, I find that I prefer animals which look like they might all be individuals of a single breed, rather than the other currently available reskins which try to make the animals very different from each other.  This fits the idea of the farm as a breeding herd without leaving all of the animals looking like identical clones.

These are recolored skins which have very minor tweaks from the default vanilla animal sprites.  For the most part they have been slightly shifted in hue, saturation, or brightness, though a few have other small changes.  Some of the cows have different shaped spots, for example. 

Currently, there are:
 - 23 blue chickens
 - 16 brown chickens
 - 15 brown cows
 - 39 dinosaurs
 - 9 ducks
 - 12 goats
 - 20 golden chickens
 - 16 ostriches
 - 9 pigs
 - 9 rabbits
 - 9 sheep
 - 21 void chickens
 - 17 white chickens
 - 9 white cows

This mod doesn't have cats, dogs, or horses, as those aren't animals that can be bred and "traded" for meat with Animal Husbandry Mod and therefore have less reason to want many very similar sprite recolors of.

Downloads.Description: Remember to put the files in Mods/AdoptSkin/assets/skins
